## Appearance

Nell features gray eyes that resemble stars or the morning sky, along with a small pointed chin and a remarkably lovely nose. She has a tip of a lengthy crimson plait or thick waves of red hair, which she once disastrously dyed green. When walking, she displays a graceful carriage and expressive face that brightens when she is excited.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 c30 P28](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0028), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000)_

## Personality

Nell is an imaginative, romantic, and highly spirited girl who frequently escapes into a realm of rich fantasy. Though prone to sudden outbursts of temper and impulsive mishaps, she possesses a strong sense of duty, quick empathy, and a deep determination to take responsibility for her mistakes. As she matures, her vivid imagination and quick humor convert her youthful trials into literary creativity and deep devotion toward her friends and family.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P98](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0098), [v1 c19 P74](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0074), [v2 c2 P33](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0033), [v2 c20 P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v3 c2 P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)_

## History

After being sent to live at Grey Shutters with Thirza Abernethy, Nell quickly formed a deep bond with her best friend, Isolde Pembroke. At school in Brierley, she got into frequent scrapes due to her vivid imagination and quick temper, including breaking a slate over Hugh Carrow's head after he teased her red hair, and accidentally dyeing her hair green before a major event. Winning the prestigious Avery Prize, she decided to defer college to teach school in Delford and Brierley so she could care for Thirza during her failing eyesight. Later, she attended college, where she began publishing short fiction stories. Although pursued by Cyril and Barney Pullen, she declined their proposals, realizing her true sentiments. Eventually, she married Dr. Carrow and survived a severe, prolonged illness following the birth of her son, Harcourt.

_Sources: [v1 c7 P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 c12 P13](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0013), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P20](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0020), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 c38 P29](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0029), [v1 c38 P35](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0035), [v2 c6 P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003), [v3 c8 P13](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0013), [v3 c15 P11](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0011), [v3 c38 P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v5 c1 P4](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0004)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia to Edmund and Bertha Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Orphaned as a young child when her parents passed away  <sub>[v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 c21 P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020), [v3 c21 P22](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0022)</sub>
- Taken in by Thirza Abernethy at Grey Shutters in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c7 P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 c12 P15](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0015), [v1 c18 P0](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0000)</sub>

## Quotes

> I turned eleven this past March,” Nell stated, giving in to plain reality with a faint sigh. “And Nova Scotia’s Harborough is where I was born. Edmund Harcourt was my father’s name, and he worked as a teacher at the Harborough High School. Bertha Harcourt was my mother’s name.  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>

> You vile, spiteful youth!” she cried out with deep emotion. “How could you!  <sub>[v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037)</sub>

> Yes, it is green,” Nell groaned. “I believed that red hair was as terrible as anything could be. However, I realize now that possessing green hair is ten times more awful. Oh, Thirza, you have no idea how completely miserable I feel.  <sub>[v1 c27 P18](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0018)</sub>

> However, I shall still learn Greek and Latin, Mrs. Sowerby,” Nell stated with a laugh. “My intention is to complete my Arts degree right here at Grey Shutters, pursuing all the subjects that I would have taken at university.  <sub>[v1 c38 P32](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0032)</sub>

> My father and mother have been FOUND by me. They have been made REAL to me by those letters. I am no longer an orphan. It feels to me as though I opened a book and discovered sweet, beloved roses of yesterday pressed between its pages.  <sub>[v3 c21 P22](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0022)</sub>
